correctness.rationale: Möbius seasonal transfer T(K,h)=[[rK-(r-1)h,-Kh],[r-1,K]] has determinant rK²; multiplying exact matrices gives trace difference (H-L)(r-1)²(K1-K2), and fixed-point polynomial difference Q_HL-Q_LH=-(H-L)(r-1)R(x). Since R(0)=-K1K2<0 and its leading coefficient r-1>0, R has exactly one positive root xi; common smaller positive roots of both maps require x=xi, giving at most one possible H*=g_K2(g_K1(xi)-L)-xi. Continuity of simple physical lower roots excludes a second ordering reversal on each connected admissible interval. Two concave increasing Beverton-Holt steps with two positive roots have the smaller root as repelling basin boundary; both first-season states need positivity, explicitly checked in the example. Independent symbolic multiplication and exact-radical checks reproduce H*=(1345-159sqrt57)/293, the root ordering reversal between H=1/4 and 1/2, and positivity of two physical roots throughout. Numerical endpoint values corroborate, do not replace full algebraic interval proof.
